title: Page 32
transc:
Ft. Monroe March 1st  / 64
Maj Eckert Di 
Arabia an agent is here from
Claudius endorsed by Senator Clark who
desires that I shall send home
about four hundred Clarence men on
fur low to vote at the
Election period I can spare them
for ten or fifteen days but
they have no other claim to
go shall I send them period
all veterans have gone Abbey Gertrude
Geo D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe Mar 1st 1864
John Horner New York
for William Lee Chief detective Vermont
Hays office Midas will try &
get a description period in mean
time put the letter in office
and watch it period It will
bring him I know he is
expecting it signed Abbey Gertrude cloudy
Geo D Sheldon
